title: Monster Phase 2 Step 2 — Streamlit health fallback
root_cause: The legacy Streamlit Community Cloud /_stcore/health liveness endpoint returned a stable HTTP 404 for the full verifier window, blocking the verifier before it could execute the already-required public root and real-browser production contract.
patch: Treat only HTTP 404 from the legacy health endpoint as an explicit root-browser transport fallback. Preserve the root HTTP proof, real Playwright production proof, all API identity checks, all CFB safety checks, and fail-closed behavior for every other non-200 health state.
